notes.title: Dev Update 2: Beware of what lurks under the ocean!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/70e036fb08db98f9c2f78b3e31b5ddaff60bdc18.png

Arrr!	

The Seadevil has been spotted roaming the ocean! Stalking the seas, this colossal predator charges through the waters leaving destruction in its wake. Sighted by few and survived by fewer, tales of its wrath serve as a warning to all who would dare challenge its rule. Beware, for those who choose to cross its path must surely have a death wish.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/5253b10c03479bdc26386a1c96e6d6773bbcf45e.gif
I wouldn't wanna go near him...

While the Seadevil lurks on the ocean floor, it is not the only threat that captains will need to beware of!
The seas have grown rough, and danger looms on the horizon! So hoist the sails, man the cannons, and set forth into the vast beyond!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/70986053fa68897d4f2db596ea0ca492d25ab609.png
Look out for more reveals!

*   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *  *   *  *   *   *   *   *   *   *  

Ahoy, me hearties! Project 99 here. Our first peek into Piratopia 2.0 was met with great enthusiasm, and this gives us great encouragement as we forge ahead with finding ways to make this pirate dream a reality! Join our community on Discord  for more events and other exciting updates!

notes.title: Dev Update 1: Charting new waters in Piratopia 2.0!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/aa331d71a6aa0218a389e13f7a81c4663e75a9e2.png
Ahoy Mateys! 

We’re thrilled to haul out a bit of what we have been plundering and want to give you a taste of some of our creations thus far in 2022! We know your thirst for new treasures and adventures is strong, and we want to thank everyone for being so supportive and patient with us. Your trust in our pirating ways will be well rewarded! Now let us get into some updates that will include several new features that we know you will love. 

New Ship Classes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/f3e51aa730eda4b52d17d33c9a61955f747fc10f.png
With a new class-based system, you can choose to play as the Dreadnought, the imposing figure in any fleet, the Destroyer, designed to deliver massive damage with its vast array of weaponry, or the Cruiser, outmaneuvering the enemies and delivering quick successions of hit-and-run tactics. 

Players will now have a wider range of strategies and play styles to choose from which will open up new opportunities for them to take on new challenges and enjoy the game in new ways. 

The Crew System 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/a9a17bb6d68409e7c9985fb5ab9f92c1f8017d66.png
Get your rum ready, they are thirsty!

Players will come across various crewmates they can recruit throughout the game. By recruiting them to your ship, players will be able to access new passive and active abilities that will boost different ship skills and change the playstyle. 

Players can customize their builds with the abilities that they unlock, creating a more personalized and immersive experience. Players will be able to mix and match crewmates to create a unique and powerful crew, and set out to conquer the seas.

UI Overhaul 
Players will find a cleaner and more intuitive layout, making navigating the game easier and accessing all the features they need. We have also included new tooltips and tutorials to help new players get started. Here are some snippets of what you can expect...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/610d4635d69a93d5b255d6a1fa294038ae49b8eb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/6394e50bdc4647a93e57e835313666f4fdee9989.jpg

We're working on new content, new abilities, and new adventures.



But before we go...
Is it just us... 


or is something in the waters below...?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802930/97d5a745808c30cb2470afb5d8aaa2102356f8d7.jpg

notes.title: Piratopia Release!
notes.notes:
Hey Pirates,

Thank you for taking parts in the public betas, it helped me finish the project up to a releasable state and even improving it beyond the initial scope!

Finally, I'm happy to announce the release date!

11th of November 2021 - 7pm BST time

I can't wait to battle pirates in the open seas together once again!

Join our community to suggest improvements or report bugs
https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

Let's Plunder the open seas, Arrrrgh!
